decision: agent_card as a separate tenant-isolated FORCE-RLS table (migration 032), one row per employee(kind='agent'), schema-only and runtime-dormant day-1. FR-2 (card only for agents) enforced declaratively via a composite-FK-into-redundant-discriminator-key idiom: migration 032 adds UNIQUE (tenant_id, id, kind) on employee, agent_card carries employee_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent' pinned by CHECK (employee_kind='agent'), and FK (tenant_id, employee_id, employee_kind) -> employee(tenant_id, id, kind) — no trigger. budget_policy_id and escalation_rule_id are uuid NULL with NO FK (T-0023 instance_budget unlanded; no escalation_rule table at all — deferred per the 017 'impossible FK = BUILD bounce' lesson). 5 dev agents seeded ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. No prompt/instruction column (T-0123 competence layer adds it additively). No new TS module, no HTTP endpoint. Live-verified against the running silo Postgres (migrations 001-031 already applied); DB left pristine.

rejected_alternatives.option: Agent columns directly on employee (no separate table)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: 9 agent-only nullable columns on every human row; muddier intent; T-0123/Stage-2 additions pollute the org-core table. Backlog signature names a table (agent_card(employee_id, ...)).
Procedural second enforcement surface; the composite-FK-into-redundant-key idiom enforces FR-2 declaratively with zero code.

rejected_alternatives.option: Plain composite FK (tenant_id, employee_id) -> employee(tenant_id, id) only
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Cannot restrict on kind; would admit cards for kind='human' employees, violating FR-2.

rejected_alternatives.option: Declare budget_policy_id FK to instance_budget in migration 032
rejected_alternatives.why_not: instance_budget (T-0023) is not applied in the live DB; the FK target does not exist -> migration fails to apply = BUILD bounce (017 lesson). FK deferred to T-0023.
No escalation_rule table exists anywhere yet. Impossible FK. Column is uuid NULL with no FK; the future escalation task adds it.
Competence layer is T-0123's scope (product-audit 2026-06-11 seam). Table kept narrow + additively extensible.

rejected_alternatives.option: Separate seed script outside the migration
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates the T-0053 one-bring-up-path principle (NF-4). Seed stays inside migration 032 behind ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

rejected_alternatives.option: Reuse the shared human empIdA/empIdB in the cross_tenant seedRowForTable agent_card case
rejected_alternatives.why_not: seedEmployeeRow seeds kind='human' (line 177); the kind-FK rejects it. The agent_card case must seed its own kind='agent' employee inline (order-independent, like the role case).

contracts: Migration 032: ALTER TABLE choros.employee ADD CONSTRAINT employee_tenant_id_id_kind_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, id, kind).

Migration 032: CREATE TABLE choros.agent_card (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, employee_id uuid NOT NULL, employee_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent', kc_client_id text NOT NULL, llm_endpoint text NULL, llm_model text NULL, llm_secret_handle text NULL, autonomy_threshold numeric(5,4) NULL, budget_policy_id uuid NULL, escalation_rule_id uuid NULL, created_at bigint NOT NULL, updated_at bigint NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, employee_id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, kc_client_id), CONSTRAINT agent_card_employee_kind_chk CHECK (employee_kind='agent'), CONSTRAINT agent_card_autonomy_threshold_chk CHECK (autonomy_threshold IS NULL OR (autonomy_threshold >= 0 AND autonomy_threshold <= 1)), CONSTRAINT agent_card_employee_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, employee_id, employee_kind) REFERENCES choros.employee(tenant_id, id, kind)).

Migration 032: ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; POLICY agent_card_tenant_isolation USING/WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid); GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON choros.agent_card TO choros_app (no DDL).
Migration 032: dev seed of 5 agent cards for DEV_TENANT a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
